subject.title: The information I really need from this app

question: Should CodexBar expose a numerical five-hour-session-equivalent forecast, or keep the existing time-to-limit and conservative headroom wording?
rationale: The available percentages support several plausible estimates, but choosing precision, thresholds, wording, and menu placement is a product decision rather than a correctness fix.

options.title: Add conservative session equivalents
options.body: Show an explicitly approximate count derived through the existing pace model only when both reset windows provide reliable data.

options.title: Keep qualitative pacing
options.body: Retain the current reserve, time-to-limit, and headroom language to avoid implying that five-hour and weekly consumption are directly interchangeable.

recommendation.title: Add conservative session equivalents
recommendation.body: Show an explicitly approximate count derived through the existing pace model only when both reset windows provide reliable data.
